description: Use this when an authenticated SIMcloud user asks to buy a confirmed VAS voucher. Call list_vas_products first and use an available product and denomination. This spends wallet funds and queues an irreversible external transaction; do not automatically retry an ambiguous result.

product_id.description: SIMcloud VAS product ID. Required when voucher_type is not supplied.

voucher_type.description: Exact VAS voucher type or slug. Required when product_id is not supplied.

name: create_vas_order

ok.description: Whether the proxied SIMcloud API request returned a 2xx response.

status.description: HTTP status returned by the SIMcloud API, or 0 when no HTTP response was received.

title: Create VAS order
